title: Chaos in the double pendulum at every energy
plain: The planar double pendulum with equal masses and arms is chaotic at moderate energies. Prove it is chaotic at every energy above the rest state, however small.
math: Let $H$ be the Hamiltonian of the planar double pendulum with $m_1=m_2=\ell_1=\ell_2=g=1$, with minimum $E_0$. Prove that for every $E>E_0$ the flow on $\{H=E\}$ has positive topological entropy.
